```yaml
name: Bump Progressive Rollout Version Command

on:
  issue_comment:
    types: [created]

jobs:
  bump:
    if: |
      github.event.issue.pull_request != null &&
      contains(github.event.comment.body, '/bump-progressive-rollout-version')
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version-file: .python-version
          cache: pip

      - name: Install just
        uses: extraction/setup-just@v3
        with:
          just-version: 1.7.0
          github-token: ${{ secrets.GH_PAT_APPROVINGTON_OCTAVIA }}

      - name: Get GitHub App token
        uses: DataDog/dd-octo-sts-action@acaa02eee7e3bb0839e4272dacb37b8f3b58ba80
        with:
          domain: github.com
          audience: https://github.com
          scope: repo
          policy: read-write
        id: octo

      - name: Bump connector version
        id: bump
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ steps.octo.outputs.token }}
        run: |
          NEW_VERSION=$(airbyte-ci connectors --modified bump-version --rc)
          echo "new_version=$NEW_VERSION" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          echo "NEW_VERSION=$NEW_VERSION" >> $GITHUB_ENV

      - name: Comment on PR
        uses: actions/github-script@v6
        with:
          github-token: ${{ secrets.GH_PAT_APPROVINGTON_OCTAVIA }}
          script: |
            const newVersion = '${{ steps.bump.outputs.new_version }}';
            const commentBody = `✅ Successfully bumped connector version to \`${newVersion}\`. The connector is now ready for a progressive rollout. Next steps: run tests, create a PR, and merge to main.`;
            await github.issues.createComment({
              issue_number: context.issue.number,
              owner: context.repo.owner,
              repo: context.repo.repo,
              body: commentBody
            });
```
